title: First Turkish identity card (T.C. Kimlik Kartı)
scope: Turkish citizens applying in Türkiye for their first chip identity card (T.C. Kimlik Kartı): after a birth, after acquiring Turkish citizenship, or to replace an old paper nüfus cüzdanı.
excluded: renewal of an existing chip card (see tc_kimlik_renewal)
foreigners: they receive a foreigner identity number with their residence permit
people under legal restriction and children under state protection

stages.title: ID card application at the population directorate (nüfus müdürlüğü)

fields.name: is_turkish_citizen
fields.question: Is the future card holder a Turkish citizen?

fields.name: applying_in_turkiye
fields.question: Will you apply at a population directorate (nüfus müdürlüğü) in Türkiye?

fields.name: application_reason
fields.question: Why is the card needed: birth, citizenship (newly acquired) or nufus_cuzdani (replacing the old paper ID)?

fields.name: birth_date
fields.question: What is the date of birth of the future card holder?

fields.name: application_date
fields.question: On which date will you apply (your appointment date)?

fields.name: registered_in_family_register
fields.question: Is the acquired citizenship already registered in the family register (aile kütüğü)?

fields.name: residence_address_registered
fields.question: Is your residence address registered in the address register (MERNİS adres kaydı)?

fields.name: citizenship_announcement_present
fields.question: Do you have the official announcement (duyuru belgesi) that you acquired Turkish citizenship?

fields.name: photo_id_present
fields.question: Will the card holder bring a valid identity document with a photo (nüfus cüzdanı, passport, driving licence...)?

fields.name: relative_statement_available
fields.question: If there is no photo ID: can a parent, spouse, adult sibling or adult child come to confirm the identity?

fields.name: nufus_cuzdani_present
fields.question: Will you bring the old nüfus cüzdanı that the card replaces?

fields.name: photo_date
fields.question: When was the biometric photo taken?

fields.name: travel_document_use
fields.question: Will the card be used as a travel document?

fields.name: applies_in_person
fields.question: Will the card holder go to the office in person?

fields.name: legal_representative_applies
fields.question: For a child under 15: will a parent, guardian or another allowed relative make the application?

fields.name: birth_notified_within_legal_period
fields.question: Was the birth notified within the legal period (30 days in Türkiye)?

fields.name: fee_payment_date
fields.question: On which date did you pay the card fee (değerli kâğıt bedeli)?

fields.name: fee_is_current_year_rate
fields.question: Is the amount you paid the fee published for the year of your application?

fields.name: appointment_booked
fields.question: Do you have an appointment (randevu.nvi.gov.tr, Alo 199, e-Devlet, NVİ Mobil or Nüfusmatik)?

fields.name: holder_name
fields.question: What is the full name of the future card holder?
